compiled_state.title: [implementation-plan]: Spec phases lack task-level coverage assertion -> Phases specified but never implemented
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** 5d5f6e904dd3c8d731c8fcd956fb288790b884c9
* **Skill:** plugins/dso/skills/implementation-plan/SKILL.md

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** Sub-Agent Blocker (planning-model defect)

**Filed by d076 post-mortem analysis (`docs/findings/d076-postmortem-analysis.md`) — implementation deferred to a remediation sprint.**

#### Expected Behavior

When implementation-plan decomposes a story whose acceptance criteria or description names multiple phases of work (e.g., "SPLIT phase generates filtered patches, then PUBLISH phase creates branches"), the resulting task list must include a task per named phase, AND a final completion-verifier task that asserts every named phase has a corresponding test. Spec phases that appear in the story description without task coverage are a planning failure surfaced at implementation-plan time, not a runtime discovery.

#### Actual Behavior

Bug cf84-9c07-00f8-4ad6 documents that redistribute-session-commits.sh's SPLIT phase was specified ("partition session-branch commits by DSO-Story trailer, generate one filtered patch per target story branch") but the implementation bulk-cherry-picked instead. Implementation-plan and completion-verifier on that story both passed without catching the discrepancy.

### 3. Action History

The story description had structured "phase" language. The task breakdown did not preserve the structure.

### 4. Chronological Rationalization

Spec-vs-implementation gaps on multi-phase tools are a recurring pattern (cf84 here; comparable gaps in other rescue tools). A phase-coverage assertion adds maybe one extra task per multi-phase story.

### 5. Skills and Workflows

Affected skill: implementation-plan. Suggested implementation: parse the story description for ordered-list / named-phase patterns; require one task per phase; emit a phase-coverage manifest that completion-verifier consumes.

### 6. Logs

Reference: docs/findings/d076-postmortem-analysis.md §3 bug cf84 row + §6 row 5.

comments.body: /dso:fix-bug BASIC investigation: implementation-plan SKILL.md has no phase-coverage assertion logic on HEAD. Classification: COMPLEX — requires (a) defining a reliable 'named-phase pattern' parser in an LLM instruction file (non-trivial heuristics for 'SPLIT/PUBLISH phase' vs ordinary prose); (b) new manifest contract between implementation-plan and completion-verifier; (c) behavioral test. Recommend creating an epic to scope the phase-detection heuristic and manifest schema before implementing. Leaving OPEN.
